summary: Verified fix for 'stampa fattura con più rate'. Backend pytest (6/6 pass): invoices with 3 unsorted rate are sorted and scadenza=last rata; sum mismatch -> 422; XML has one DettaglioPagamento per rata with TP01 (>1) / TP02 (single scadenza or 1 rata); courtesy_pdf (real invoice from API) shows bold 'Scadenze di pagamento' table with 1/3..3/3, dates, 122,00 € each, no literal <b> tags, no 'Scadenza pagamento:' line (PDF rendered to image and visually checked); single scadenza and 1-rata invoices show 'Scadenza pagamento: dd/mm/yyyy'; layout campi.scadenza=false hides both. UI /fatture/{id}/stampa: print-rate table with print-rata-1..3 (3 rate) and 1..2 (2 rate) showing n/N, date, amount, no ' · Scadenza'; single scadenza / 1 rata shows ' · Scadenza dd/mm/yyyy'; with scadenza layout off neither shown. All TEST_T68 data deleted (verified 0 remaining).
critical_code_review_comments: Minor inconsistency: courtesy_pdf filters rate without scadenza before counting, InvoicePrint uses inv.rate as-is. Harmless today because RataIn.scadenza is required, but legacy docs with null scadenza would render differently.
seed_data_creation: Temporary TEST_T68 company/client/4 invoices + test admin session via mongosh; all deleted afterwards.
